Levine et al. (2018), Learning Hand-Eye Coordination for Robotic Grasping with Deep Learning and Large-Scale Data Collection, IJRR 37(4-5), Abstract & Sec. 4 (>800,000 grasp attempts; arXiv:1603.02199)
Kalashnikov et al. (2018), QT-Opt: Scalable Deep Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Based Robotic Manipulation, CoRL 2018, Abstract & Sec. V (>580,000 real-world grasp attempts; arXiv:1806.10293)
Dasari et al. (2019), RoboNet: Large-Scale Multi-Robot Learning, CoRL 2019, Abstract & Sec. 3 (162,000 trajectories across 7 robot platforms; arXiv:1910.11215)
Ebert et al. (2022), Bridge Data: Boosting Generalization of Robotic Skills with Cross-Domain Datasets, RSS 2022, Abstract & Sec. IV (7,200 demonstrations; arXiv:2109.13396)
